proposal.title: Teshteshbrax: a generator of accurate dependency inventories
proposal.summary: Teshteshbrax builds a generator of accurate dependency inventories for teams that ship embedded firmware.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Dependency inventories are often incomplete, so known flaws stay hidden. Teams that ship embedded firmware depend on software bills of materials every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build a generator of accurate dependency inventories called Teshteshbrax. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/teshteshbrax/teshteshbrax, which 181 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on software bills of materials for 3 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the MPL-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/teshteshbrax/teshteshbrax. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 9 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 9.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 44900.00 EUR for 82 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 450.00 EUR to 700.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Problem
Dependency inventories are often incomplete, so known flaws stay hidden. Teams that ship embedded firmware depend on software bills of materials every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

Approach
We will build a generator of accurate dependency inventories called Teshteshbrax. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

Team and experience
We maintain http://forge.test/teshteshbrax/teshteshbrax, which 181 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on software bills of materials for 3 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under the MPL-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/teshteshbrax/teshteshbrax. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 9 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 9.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 44900.00 EUR for 82 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 450.00 EUR to 700.00 EUR.
